article_notes: Four splenectomised dogs experimentally infected with B. gibsoni and treated (diminazene, then clindamycin/metronidazole/doxycycline). Per-dog time courses only; within-dog Pearson correlations of platelet count and CRP with PCV during the recovery phase are treatment-response analyses over time (excluded by the guide) and their coefficients are given only in figures. No severity or outcome group comparison. Nothing extracted.

not_extracted.what: Within-dog correlations of PLT and plasma CRP with PCV during the recovery phase (Figs 2 and 3)
not_extracted.note: Serial treatment-response correlations in 4 experimental dogs; excluded as change over time after treatment, and r values are in figures only.
